style: Authentic vintage 1960s cookbook photograph, like a Betty Crocker or Good Housekeeping step-by-step picture cookbook. Shot on 1960s Kodachrome/Ektachrome film and reproduced by offset lithography in a printed cookbook: slightly faded and yellowed, warm magenta-orange color cast, visible film grain, soft focus edges, harsh direct studio flash with hard shadows, lower contrast, NOT a modern digital photo, NOT sharp, looks like an authentic 1963 color food photograph. The image must be the photograph ONLY, full-bleed edge to edge: no book pages, no paper borders, no page edges, no captions. Setting: a 1960s American kitchen with an avocado-green formica countertop with boomerang pattern, harvest-gold and orange accents, a woman's hands with neat coral-pink nail polish and a modest wedding ring where hands are visible, crisp white cuff of a blouse. No text, no words, no labels, no captions, no watermarks anywhere in the image.

prompts.hero: No hands or people in this shot. A grand 1960s Thanksgiving buffet hero shot: an oval white Fire-King milk-glass platter with gold rim heaped with twice-baked RUSSET POTATO HALVES (cut lengthwise, crisp salted brown skins), each mounded high with fluffy creamy mashed-potato filling, the fork-roughed peaks baked bubbling golden-brown with melted three-cheese crust, lightly dusted with bright red sweet paprika, scattered with TINY crispy fried grated crumbles (not large cubes, not raw) of sujuk (a dark brick-red, dry-cured, paprika-spiced Turkish beef sausage) and bright green sliced fresh chives. Background: harvest-gold tablecloth, brass candlesticks with ivory tapers, autumn oak leaves, small gourds, and a roast turkey platter softly blurred in the far background.
prompts.s1: Close-up: a black cast-iron skillet on a gas stove burner with finely diced quarter-inch cubes of sujuk (a dark brick-red, dry-cured, paprika-spiced Turkish beef sausage) crisping in glossy rendered orange-red fat, ONE hand stirring with a wooden spoon. Beside the stove, a white plate lined with a paper towel holding drained crispy dark-red sujuk cubes, and a small glass dish of raw finely grated dark-red sujuk waiting on the avocado-green counter.
prompts.s2: Exactly ONE person, exactly TWO hands visible: on a parchment-lined sheet pan on the counter, her hands rub oil and coarse kosher salt onto a large raw russet potato; seven more pricked, oiled, salted russet potatoes lined up neatly beside it. Next to the pan, two whole heads of garlic with their tops sliced off exposing the cloves, drizzled with olive oil, sitting on open squares of aluminum foil.
prompts.s3: A small stainless-steel saucepan of foaming browned butter with golden-brown milk specks resting on the counter beside a tall metal box grater and three blocks of cheese (aged sharp white cheddar, pale yellow Gruyère with a brown rind, and a wedge of Parmigiano-Reggiano with its rind) alongside three neat mounds of freshly grated cheese on a wooden board. No hands.
prompts.s4: Exactly TWO hands: one hand holds a hot baked russet potato half (cut lengthwise) in a folded striped tea towel, the other hand scoops the steaming fluffy white flesh out with a metal spoon into a large cream-colored stoneware mixing bowl, leaving a thin quarter-inch wall of potato inside the skin. Neat rows of hollowed-out potato skin shells sit on parchment-lined sheet pans beside the bowl.
prompts.s5: A vintage tinned-steel hand-crank food mill (round hopper with a perforated medium plate, a long side handle, and a rotary crank with a wooden knob) resting on the rim of a large cream-colored stoneware mixing bowl. Exactly TWO hands: one holds the side handle steady, the other turns the crank. Fluffy fine strands of milled white potato fall into the bowl below. Soft squeezed-out roasted garlic cloves and empty garlic skins sit on a small saucer nearby.
prompts.s6: Close-up of a large cream-colored stoneware mixing bowl of velvety mashed potato filling; ONE hand folds it with a red rubber spatula, mixing in grated cheeses, bright green sliced chives, chopped thyme, and crispy fried dark-red sujuk cubes. Around the bowl on the avocado-green counter: a small glass dish of sour cream, an unwrapped foil brick of cream cheese, a small bowl of browned butter, and a small Pyrex glass pitcher of heavy cream. No other hands.
prompts.s7: Exactly TWO hands: one hand uses a large spoon to mound creamy potato filling high into hollowed russet potato skin shells on a parchment-lined sheet pan, while the other hand steadies the shell. Several finished shells are mounded high with fork-roughed peaks and generously sprinkled with shredded white cheddar, Gruyère, and Parmigiano cheese from small bowls beside the pan.
prompts.s8: A sheet pan fresh from the oven of twice-baked russet potato halves, the filling baked bubbling and golden-brown with melted cheese. Exactly ONE hand holds a tiny wire mesh tea strainer dusting bright red sweet paprika over the tops from above. Small bowls of TINY crispy fried grated dark-red sujuk crumbles and bright green sliced chives wait nearby. Wisps of steam rising.
